title: Frozen relational event past-only commit-policy feasibility audit
purpose: Determine whether deterministic stable triggering, short-gap suppression and seed-consensus refusal can rescue the frozen relational event outputs without retraining.

approval.scope: One immutable zero-training C07 selection/C08 transfer audit over sealed outputs; zero C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method choices and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C07-C08 causal identity/episode arrays from the action-set cache.
Three sealed selection probability archives from the relational capacity FAIL.
Sealed relational capacity summary and evidence seal.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Use every sealed selection observation exactly once; C07 selects one state policy and C08 receives one unchanged transfer application.

teacher.source: Corrected causal junction/terminal episode target and episode ID.
teacher.valid_mask: C07/C08 world suffix and sealed past-only traversal sequence.
teacher.student_input: No training. Policy sees only three frozen class probabilities, current/past sequence state and deployment stream boundary.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: A commit is provisional until consensus persists; release is past-only; Teacher identity is scoring-only.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: Checkpoints remain sealed. C07 selects one policy from the exact finite grid; C08 is applied once with no adaptation.
split.historical_pollution_audit: The capacity FAIL is bound as input; exploratory values motivate the audit but cannot change the frozen grid or gates.

methods.main: Per-event 2/3 or 3/3 seed consensus, 1-3 causal stable frames and 2/3/5/8-frame release, using a fixed 14-value class-probability grid; select safety first and maximum macro-F1 on C07, then transfer once to C08.
methods.baseline: Sealed stateless probability-mean ensemble and old pooled-token model macro-F1 0.743847.
methods.fallback: If C07 or C08 misses the exact safety or +0.05 macro-F1 gate, reject a hand-written state-machine rescue and require a genuinely structured one-commit learning formulation or stop the route.

acceptance.population: Exactly 21548 C07 and 24394 C08 observations, 533/603 decision episodes and all twenty development worlds.
acceptance.policy_grid: 336 policies per event from 14 thresholds x 2 vote counts x 3 stable lengths x 4 release lengths.
acceptance.safety: C07 and C08 independently require aggregate precision>=0.995, false<=0.005, recall>=0.25 and per-event precision/recall>=0.99/0.25.
acceptance.gain: C07 and C08 independently require macro-F1>=0.793847, five points above the exact pooled baseline.
acceptance.system: Exact 461/18/5/3 stateless attribution, zero optimizer/new inference/C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner, source unchanged and complete evidence.

failure_policy: Any population, identity, source, causal, grid, safety, gain, transfer or isolation failure seals FAIL; do not widen the grid, lower gates or enter graph.
retention: Retain selected policy, full grid table, C07/C08 metrics, failure decomposition, paper figure/source, log, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only replay of frozen probabilities through a finite causal state grid
